verdicts.reason: A uses a sensible left-to-right banner layout: can on the left, then logo, headline, CTA and legal stacked on the right. Its flaws: the CTA pill is oversized and nearly as heavy as the headline, the right circle crowds the headline and button, there's a dead gap between the can and the text, and the can label renders as 'SCLSTICE'. In B the headline is so big it wraps and leaves 'fizz' alone on its own line. The legal text is squeezed to an illegible size beside the CTA, the logo sits cramped on top of the circle above the can, and the can is jammed toward the bottom-left edge, so the hierarchy and spacing are broken.
